note:
Holes that are known and accepted. audit.py fails on anything worse than this.
Every entry carries a reason a person wrote -- an accepted hole with no explanation is just an unnoticed one.
no-image counts cards with no artwork from ANY source; cards filled from pokemontcg.io or TCGplayer are not holes and are not counted here.

B1a.reason: Pokemon TCG Pocket. These cards are digital-only -- never printed, never sold, and absent from every physical card database. There is no second source to fill them from, and no price either, which is correct rather than missing.

bwp.reason: BW Black Star Promos: two cards with no art upstream and no product photo.

exu.reason: Unseen Forces Unown Collection. One Unown has no art anywhere. The two unsafe-id entries are 'exu-!' and 'exu-%3F' -- both are in the catalog correctly, but the app's TcgDex.variantsInSet filters ids to alphanumerics plus '-._', so those two have never had a variants lookup. That is an app-side fix, not a catalog hole.

jumbo.reason: Upstream lists zero cards for this set despite claiming 160. Confirmed with pull_catalog.py --counts, so it is not a failed fetch. Oversized jumbo cards are catalogued by TCGdex but never populated.

mep.reason: Mega Evolution Black Star Promos. Recent enough that TCGdex is still filling it in -- 80 of 89 came from TCGplayer, and these nine have no product yet. Worth re-running fill_gaps.py on this set rather than treating it as permanent.

mfb.reason: My First Battle. Upstream is short 14 of the 48 cards claimed, and two of the 34 it does list have no art and no TCGplayer product.

rc.reason: Radiant Collection: upstream lists zero of the 25 cards it claims. Confirmed by --counts, so nothing here can supply them.

sp.reason: The e-Card 'Sample' set: upstream lists zero of 10. Confirmed by --counts.

tk-hs-g.reason: HGSS-era Trainer Kit. 27 of 30 filled from TCGplayer product photos; these three have no product listing.

tk-sm-l.reason: SM-era Trainer Kit, and upstream is also short 12 of the 30 cards it claims. Two were fillable from TCGplayer; the rest are deck-exclusive.

tk-sm-r.reason: SM-era Trainer Kit. Same story as the XY kits -- three of its thirty cards had a TCGplayer product photo, the rest are deck-exclusive.

tk-xy-b.reason: XY-era Trainer Kit. TCGdex has no art for any of it; pokemontcg.io does not carry the XY Trainer Kits at all (only the EX-era ones, tk1a/tk1b/tk2a/tk2b); and the cards are deck-exclusive rather than sold as singles, so TCGplayer has no product to photograph. All three tiers genuinely exhausted.
